<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/gateway_accounts/{gwa}/webhook_endpoint"}
#docs
For gateways with no provisioning API (RazorPay), this also carries the shared secret WE generated for the operator to paste. `?reveal=true` includes the secret (the dashboard's Show/Copy action) and needs `gateways:manage`; omitted otherwise.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `gwa` | `string` | **yes** | The gateway account's id (gwa_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reveal` | `string` | no | Set to `true` to include the webhook secret. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gateway_key` | `string` | The gateway that processed the payment. One of `tmtest`, `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `authorizenet`, `square`, `mollie`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `notification_url` | `string` | The URL to register at the gateway for this account. |
| `secret` | `string` | Our generated secret to paste into the gateway. Only for `paste_required`, and only with `?reveal=true`. |
| `webhook_id` | `string` | The gateway webhook endpoint's webhook id. |
| `mode` | `string` | What the operator must do: nothing, we registered the endpoint (`self_provisioned`); paste our secret into the gateway (`paste_required`); paste the gateway's secret into this account as `webhook_secret` (`secret_in`); register the URL at the gateway, as signatures use the API credentials (`url_only`); or nothing, the gateway sends no webhooks (`not_applicable`). One of `self_provisioned`, `paste_required`, `secret_in`, `url_only`, `not_applicable`. |
| `configured` | `boolean` | We hold what we need to check signatures. For `url_only` this is always true; only the gateway knows whether the URL is registered. |
| `instructions` | `array of string` | The gateway webhook endpoint's instructions. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such gateway account |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/gateway_accounts/gwa_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/webhook_endpoint" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "gateway_key": "tmtest",
  "notification_url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing",
  "secret": "whsec_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "webhook_id": "Webhook id",
  "mode": "self_provisioned",
  "configured": false,
  "instructions": [
    "Instruction"
  ]
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such gateway account"
  }
}
```
:::
